'''Spacers Row''' was a street in [[Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine]]. [[Spaceport Express]] and [[Quebe-Luxfause Systems headquarters]] were located on this road. One of his ramifications was the [[Paradise Road]].<ref name="CL 2016" />
